newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Land completes two wells.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Land completes two wells.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said on Friday that its two exploratory wells at South Timbalier 148 in the Gulf of Mexico are now in production.
The A-8 and A-6 sidetrack wells have increased total gross platform production to 89 million cubic feet per day and 4,100 barrels of condensate per day, Louisiana Land said.
Before the start of these wildcat wells, the platform was producing approximately seven million cubic feet of gas and 80 barrels of condensate per day, Louisiana Land said.
The company is currently drilling a fourth well, B-1, and is planning additional exploration wells in the future, Louisiana Land said.
